correctness.rationale: A direct edge-distance table for horizontal X/Y edges and matching edges yields the three collision criteria in RESULT.md, covering each unordered pair of edge types. Two omitted matched columns create indistinguishable matching edges, forcing |S|>=n-1; with at most one omitted column, every edge is vertex-edge dominated, so dominant and ordinary edge-metric minima agree. At size n-1, exactly one omitted column, no doubled columns, and each layer has >=3 selected vertices are necessary and sufficient. This requires n>=7. For n<=6, the only size-n support profiles are a full transversal or one empty and one doubled column; the collision criteria give the stated layer restrictions. Combinatorial counting then yields M_n. Independently built graph adjacencies and BFS edge distances, exhaustive minimum-size subsets n=2..8, including n=2 square and n=7 first drop, produced basis counts 4,14,50,182,532,140,560, all matching the claimed classifications. The all-n conclusion rests on explicit collision exhaustion, not just these tests.

originality.rationale: A 2024 Cartesian-product inequality gives n-1 <= edim(K_n square K_2) <= n but not the sharp transition or all minimum bases.
